module: Pause menu data provider for multiplayer: multiplayer home page (Session Settings / Game Modes / Manage Players buttons), session settings (PauseMultiplayerSessionTab) and player list (PauseMultiplayerPlayerList). Actions are read-only in freeroamTutorial mode.
notes: Several labels are hardcoded in English, not translated: "Session Settings", "Create Session...", "Manage Players", "Players", "Read-only in this mode".
getMultiplayerData accesses multiplayer_gamemodeManager.getCurrentGamemodeExt(): the Game Modes button leads to pause.gamemodeSettings if a mode is running, otherwise to pause.gamemodes.

getPlayerListSidePanelContents.desc: Returns the content of the "Players" side panel (title ui.multiplayer.players and PauseMultiplayerPlayerList component). Also used by routeData_gamemodes.

getMultiplayerData.desc: Returns the multiplayer home page with three navigation buttons (routes pause.multiplayer.settings, pause.gamemodes or pause.gamemodeSettings, pause.multiplayer.playerList). The last two are only enabled if a multiplayer session is active.

getMultiplayerSettingsData.desc: Returns the session settings page (PauseMultiplayerSessionTab component) with the player list as a side panel.

getMultiplayerPlayerListData.desc: Returns the player management page (PauseMultiplayerPlayerList component with interactive = true).
